def VTask.piEquivPiSubtypeProd {α : Type u_9} (p : α → Prop) (β : α → Type u_10) [DecidablePred p] :
    ((i : α) → β i) ≃ ((i : { x // p x }) → β ↑i) × ((i : { x // ¬p x }) → β ↑i) :=
  {
    toFun := fun f =>
      (fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => f x, fun ⟨x, hx⟩ => f x)
    invFun := fun ⟨f₁, f₂⟩ x =>
      if hx : p x then f₁ ⟨x, hx⟩ else f₂ ⟨x, hx⟩
    left_inv := by
      intro f
      ext x
      by_cases hx : p x <;> simp [hx]
      <;> congr 1 <;> ext ⟨y, hy⟩ <;> simp_all [Subtype.ext_iff]
      <;> aesop
    right_inv := by
      intro ⟨f₁, f₂⟩
      ext ⟨x, hx⟩
      simp [hx]
      <;> aesop
  }
